title: Finite presentation of modules descends faithfully flatly
statement: Let $R\to T$ be a faithfully flat homomorphism of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map], and let $M$ be an $R$-module. If $T\otimes_R M$ is a finitely presented $T$-module [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product; def-sc-finitely-presented-module], then $M$ is a finitely presented $R$-module.
